title: Bento Box Lunch Ideas - DIY Pasta Salad Bar
summary: Bento box lunches are an easy way to pack a variety of healthy foods for preschool, kindergarten and beyond! Here are some delicious ideas to help make packing school lunches fun and doable.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Pasta of choice, preferably whole grain or legume-based (e.g. chickpeas, lentils)
1/4 cup Protein (chicken, beef, hard-boiled egg, shrimp, beans, tofu)
cherry/grape tomatoes (quartered for 4 years and younger)
steps: Pack all the components into separate compartments. Place the pasta in the largest compartment so that if your child decides to mix up all the components together, they can!
If your lunch box is not leak-proof, be sure to add the sauce/dressing in a separate container.
